final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type AS event_type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS event_average FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), type_averages AS (SELECT event_type, AVG(event_average) AS type_average FROM event_averages GROUP BY event_type), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS overall_average FROM type_averages) SELECT t.event_type, t.type_average, t.type_average / o.overall_average FROM type_averages AS t JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE t.type_average IS NOT NULL
